4. The appeal from the judgment and order in question has already been barred by limitation. The convict prisoner has sought to avail of the provisions of section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for the relief as aforesaid. 

 6. We have gone through the judgment of the court below. We find that all the 20 (twenty) sarees seized by the BDR personnel from the possession of the convict were not produced before the court; only two pieces of sarees were produced by PW 7, the Customs Sepoy Md. Mohsin, to the Court which were found to be of Indian origin. This is the only defect, if at all, which may transpire from the judgment and order in question. This might have been taken as a ground of appeal which, as already stated, has been barred by limitation. The prime question that arises before us is whether there is any application of section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in the circumstances revealed in the instant case. 

 9. Mr. Shahid has again submitted that the petition is not without any remedy.
